title: Refer a Friend to Rho-Bank and Earn Rewards
summary: Explains how to refer a friend to Rho-Bank credit cards using a unique, account-tied referral link to earn a referral bonus once the friend is approved and meets card-specific program requirements (cash back, bonus points, or statement credits). Covers the 2 successful referrals per week rolling 7-day limit, tracking referral status in the mobile app, and confirms you can check current offers via customer service at 1-800-RHO-BANK.
faqs: How do I generate my unique Rho-Bank referral link?
When will I receive a referral bonus after my friend is approved?
What are the weekly referral bonus limits for successful referrals?
Do all Rho-Bank credit cards participate in the referral program?
What requirements might my friend need to meet to trigger the bonus?
How can I check the status of my referrals and get notifications?
keywords: referral link (unique, tied to your account)
